title: Eliciting Specifications: When Does Interactive Clarification Help?
abstract: arXiv:2610.22382v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLMs can generate Lean specifications from task descriptions, but those descriptions are often underspecified or ambiguous and may omit verifier-relevant edge cases, yielding imperfect formal specifications. We study whether an elicitation agent (EA) can improve verifier-checked Lean specifications by seeking clarification from a reference-grounded simulated developer before formalization. The agent decomposes the task, identifies unresolved decisions, asks bounded clarification questions, and uses the answers to write a refined natural-language specification that an LLM formalizer then translates into Lean. On 189 Verina Lean 4 specification-generation tasks, we compare single-shot generation with elicitation under question budgets of k=3 and k=10, allowing at most three or ten EA questions per task, across same-model and cross-model configurations. translated_title: 引出规格说明：交互式澄清何时有所帮助？
translated_abstract: LLM可以从任务描述中生成Lean规格说明，但这些描述往往不够明确或存在歧义，并且可能遗漏与验证器相关的边界情况，从而产生不完善的形式化规格说明。我们研究了一个引出代理（Elicitation Agent, EA）能否通过在形式化之前向基于参考资料构建的模拟开发者寻求澄清，来改进经过验证器检查的Lean规格说明。该代理对任务进行分解，识别尚未解决的决策点，提出有数量限制的澄清问题，并利用答案撰写精炼后的自然语言规格说明，再由LLM形式化工具将其翻译为Lean。在189个Verina Lean 4规格说明生成任务上，我们比较了单次生成与引出式方法的效果，问题预算分别设为k=3和k=10（即每个任务最多允许EA提出三个或十个问题），并涵盖了同模型与跨模型两种配置。同模型的Claude Sonnet 4.6流水线在两种……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种引出代理（EA）方法，在形式化之前向模拟开发者提出有预算限制的澄清问题以改进LLM生成的Lean规格说明，并系统评估了在不同问题预算（k=3与k=10）及同模型/跨模型配置下交互式澄清何时有效。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an elicitation agent that asks budgeted clarification questions to a reference-grounded simulated developer before formalization to improve LLM-generated Lean specifications, and systematically evaluates when interactive clarification helps under different question budgets (k=3 and k=10) across same-model and cross-model configurations.
